from playwright.sync_api import Page, expect

def test_uom_master_flow(page: Page):
    # Assumes session is authenticated
    page.goto('https://gc-dev.centralindia.cloudapp.azure.com/ambica/auth/login')
    page.click('button:has-text("Master Data")')
    page.click('a:has-text("UoM Master")')
    page.click('button:has-text("ADD UOM")')
    page.fill('#uomName', 'FEET')
    page.click('button:has-text("Submit")')
    expect(page.locator('p-toast')).to_contain_text('Success')
